Chloe — quick note from InfoSec on recommended redaction policy for external sharing:

Recommended redaction tiers for Nimbus Health request:
- Executive Summary (external):
  - Include: top-level findings, impacted component names (product-level, e.g., "API gateway"), severity and mitigation status, risk rating.
  - Exclude: PoC snippets, exploit steps, internal hostnames, full stack traces, internal service IDs, customer-identifying data.

- Remediation Tracker (external):
  - Include: finding ID (masked), summary, severity, remediation owner (team-level only), planned/actual ETA, status (Open/In progress/Closed).
  - Exclude: raw evidence links, IP addresses, log extracts.

- Full Report Access:
  - Require: signed NDA, SSO user provisioned, secure viewer session (watermarked), no persistent download. Evidence access only with [signed] evidence-handling addendum.

If Nimbus requests PoCs later, we should require a formal proof-of-need justification and an escalation to Legal for an evidence-handing addendum.

I'll prepare the redaction checklist and the masked finding IDs.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
